final:
Implemented atomic ledger batches by staging balances and committed IDs, so failures leave the ledger unchanged. Identical transfers are now skipped within a batch as well as across batches, and account IDs must be strings.

`node --test tests/visible.test.mjs` passed. Additional checks for atomicity, duplicate handling, fresh snapshots, and invalid transfers also passed.
